description: This file contains unit tests for the I18NTranslationAPI class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing API interactions related to internationalization translation endpoints in the admin plugin.

classes.name: I18NTranslationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for validating the behavior of the I18NTranslationAPI class, including fetching all translations and ensuring that create, delete, and validation rules are not implemented.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' method of the API to ensure it returns expected data for given test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for the 'testGetAll' method.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that calling 'create' on the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that 'getValidationRuleForCreate' throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that 'delete' throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that 'getValidationRuleForDelete' throws a not implemented exception.
